Marta C.: Quick Q re: out-of-cycle promotions — what’s the latest timeline and the effective date policy? Can managers request retroactive comp changes?
Sam G.: Hey Marta — good q. Standard is approvals by calibration + comp sign-off by payroll before the pay period close. Effective date is usually the start of next pay period.
Marta C.: Any exceptions for urgent retention cases?
Elaine: For critical retention we can do a retroactive pay adjustment but needs: manager case note, approval from Director + HRBP, and payroll signoff. It’s handled as a one-time bump, not a permanent backdated salary unless payroll confirms.
Benji: What about title-only promotions without comp changes? Those can be effective immediately once manager and HRBP approve, no payroll changes required.
Marta C.: Is there a formal intake for these exceptions?
People Ops Bot: Reminder: submit exception forms via the Promotions Intake form: https://redwoodinference.internal/hr/promotions-intake :memo:
Elaine: ^ use that intake. Put "RETENTION" in subject for fast routing.
Marta C.: Who reviews salary band exceptions?
Sam G.: Compensation team (cc @CompBot) does band exceptions. They evaluate against market data and internal leveling. Director sign-off required for >10% increase.
Marta C.: Any hard caps? Manager asked if we can do 25% increase for IC with competing offer.
Benji: 25% is large; usually needs exec sponsor and Finance approval. People Ops + Comp team will look at total comp and equity implications.
Sam G.: Also note we have a mid-cycle comp window next month — if you can align with that it’s much faster. Deadlines: calibration docs due by 1769080000, comp approvals by 1769150000.
Marta C.: Can contractors be promoted or get comp changes?
Elaine: Contractors cannot change title in the employee org or receive salary changes — vendors/contracting team must re-engage and convert to FTE if long-term.
Marta C.: Any special steps for overseas hires?
Benji: International comp adjustments require local legal review + payroll locale team. Add 2–3 weeks for compliance.
Marta C.: If manager wants retroactive increase to start of current month, what do they put in intake?
People Ops Bot: Fill the intake with requested effective_date, justification, approvals_so_far, and attach offer/comp rationale. Example snippet: ```effective_date: 2026-03-01\njustification: counteroffer + retention risk\napprovals: dir_jane_doe; hrbp_mark```
Sam G.: After intake we triage within 3 business days. Payroll processing timeline still applies — retro pay paid on next payroll run if approved.
Marta C.: OK thanks — one last: is there a negotiation playbook for managers?
Elaine: Yes: https://redwoodinference.internal/hr/manager-negotiation-playbook — includes bands, approval triggers, and checklist. Use the playbook + intake together. :thumbsup:
Benji: Ping me or @Sam G. if you need help filling the form.
Marta C.: Great, filing now. Thanks all :pray:
